_about: KG evaluation metrics catalog. Each metric is a SPARQL query under kg_queries/ that produces either a scalar (single row, single binding) or a small table. The twelve metrics are split into two categories: descriptive metrics (category="descriptive") inventory what was populated and are reported in dissertation §11.3 (Results, 'Knowledge graph population results'); evaluative metrics (category="evaluative") test a specific quantitative claim under a stated pass criterion and are reported in §12.4 (Evaluation, 'Provenance transparency'). See src/evaluation/README.md for the full catalog table and rationale.

metrics.title: Total triples
metrics.description: Total number of triples in the KG (after closure if loaded from viewsari_kg.inferred.ttl).

metrics.title: Instance counts by ontology class
metrics.description: Populates the instance-counts table in §11.3.2 — one row per ontology class with the materialised individual count.

metrics.title: Mention taxonomy breakdown
metrics.description: Counts per concrete mention subclass — the four leaf classes plus the artwork-specific specialisations.

metrics.title: Activity inventory
metrics.description: Number of prov:Activity instances grouped by their viewsari activity class (NER, entity linking, cooccurrence analysis).

metrics.title: Triples-per-mention (verbosity proxy)
metrics.description: Triples / mentions ratio. Tests the CIDOC-comparison claim that the Viewsari provenance template generates 12–18 triples per mention. Pass criterion: closed-graph ratio at or below the upper bound.

metrics.title: Provenance coverage — loose
metrics.description: Total annotations vs annotations with prov:wasGeneratedBy → SoftwareAgent. Tests contribution C2's full-provenance claim. Pass criterion: ratio = 1.0.

metrics.title: Provenance coverage — strict (paragraph + activity + agent)
metrics.description: Stricter variant of M06: annotations whose provenance chain reaches a paragraph AND an activity AND a prov:SoftwareAgent simultaneously. Pass criterion: ratio below M06, with the residual fully accounted for by human-annotated (prov:Person) ground-truth mentions and non-mention annotation nodes.

metrics.title: Activity → SoftwareAgent inventory
metrics.description: Each prov:Activity instance with its associated prov:SoftwareAgent (or prov:Person fallback). Confirms which model produced which run.

metrics.title: External linking coverage by entity type
metrics.description: Per-class total vs Wikidata-linked count and percentage. Tests whether person and artwork classes are reconciled to Wikidata at rates consistent with the long-tail discovery argument. Pass criterion: person rate substantially exceeds artwork rate, artwork gap explained by long tail.

metrics.title: OOKB artworks
metrics.description: Number of artworks WITHOUT a wikidata.org owl:sameAs link — the OOKB long-tail retained under stable Viewsari-internal IRIs.

metrics.title: Authority namespaces in use
metrics.description: Distinct external authorities reached through owl:sameAs (Wikidata, GeoNames, Iconclass, …).

metrics.title: Web-manifestation reachability
metrics.description: How many expression-level nodes (volume, biography, page) are reachable to a Project Gutenberg web manifestation via frbr:hasEmbodiment + rdfs:seeAlso. Tests whether every expression-level bibliographic node resolves to a Project Gutenberg URL. Pass criterion: volume and biography at 100%; page-level reachability bounded by the upstream HTML's anchor coverage.
